archetypes.name: voting-logic
archetypes.rationale: The fix changes a voting classification predicate with subtle multi-condition semantics; verify the new condition is complete and consistent across all vote combinations.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review the change to `classify_result` in `scripts/lib-vote-tally.sh`. The original condition `yes > 0 && exonerate > 0 && no == 0` was replaced with `exonerate > 0 && exonerate >= no && exonerate > yes`. Focus on: (1) correctness of the new predicate across all realistic vote distributions (e.g., yes=1, exon=1, no=1; yes=0, exon=1, no=1; yes=1, exon=2, no=0); (2) whether `exonerate >= no` vs `exonerate > no` is the right tie-breaking direction when exon and no are equal; (3) consistency with the `eligible==1` branch which uses bare `exonerate > 0`; (4) whether the `neutral` branch above (yes > 0 && yes == no) can shadow cases that should now be exonerated; (5) whether any previously-passing test case could now silently change meaning under the new predicate.
